semantics.cold: new journal instance; storage and OS caches not cold
semantics.fileProtocolOnMemory: authentication and checkpoint resync protocol with in-memory bytes; no native fsync
semantics.native: exclusive RootedJournalIO roots; fsync counters from native adapter
semantics.counters: JournalIO boundary calls/returned bytes; nested native IO inside put excluded from boundary counts
semantics.memory: before/after deltas, not peak memory; GC is uncontrolled
semantics.kernelClock: fixed at zero to exclude lifecycle/deadline effects
semantics.timing: only named operation; setup/clone/validation excluded; commit includes input payload/record construction
